major_issues.issue: 人参中 TXS 表达产量单位错写（1000× 偏差）
major_issues.correction: 原文为 '9.1 μg taxadiene/g dry weight'，草稿误写为 '9.1 mg taxadiene/g 干细胞重'。应改为 9.1 μg/g（与 Cha et al. 2012 原文 BMB Reports 45(10):589–594 一致）。

major_issues.issue: Nicotiana benthamiana 中 TXS 表达产量单位错写（1000× 偏差）
major_issues.correction: 原文为 'increase of taxadiene production level up to ~40 μg/g dry weight'，草稿误写为 '约 40 mg/g 干细胞重'。应改为 ~40 μg/g。

minor_issues.issue: 原文将 Botrytis cinerea 错误标为 'powdery mildew'（白粉病），草稿译为 '灰霉菌'（grey mold）——这一译法更准确，但未在报告中说明出处与原文献差异。建议在脚注中提示原 review 在此处存在物种-病害名错配。
minor_issues.correction: 保留 '灰霉菌' 译名并加注：原文 'powdery mildew' 为其本身笔误。

minor_issues.issue: 原文写 'Sulfolobus acidocaldavus'（拼写错误），草稿改为 'Sulfolobus acidocaldarius'（现代正确拼写）。这一校正合理但需在脚注或参考文献中保留原始拼写以免误导读者检索。
minor_issues.correction: 正文中保留现代正确拼写 'acidocaldarius'，并在参考文献条目中标注原始拼写 'acidocaldavus'。

verified_claims.claim: TXS 是紫杉醇生物合成的限速酶，催化 GGPP 环化为 taxadiene
verified_claims.evidence: 'Taxadiene synthase (TXS) is the rate-limiting enzyme in the biosynthesis of paclitaxel… TXS catalyzes the conversion of the diterpene precursor geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate (GGPP) into the diterpene taxadiene.'

verified_claims.claim: TXS 的 k_cat/K_M = 3.5 × 10³ s⁻¹ M⁻¹，比其他植物萜类环化酶低约 2 个数量级
verified_claims.evidence: 'TXS activity (kcat/KM = 3.5 × 10³ S⁻¹ M⁻¹) (Hezari et al., 1995) is ~2 orders of magnitude less active compared to other plant terpene cyclases.'

verified_claims.claim: Table I：TXS 的 K_M = 3 μM, k_cat = 0.0106 s⁻¹, k_cat/K_M = 3.5 × 10³ s⁻¹ M⁻¹
Ajikumar et al. 2010 多变量模块化策略将大肠杆菌 taxadiene 产量提升至 1 g/L
verified_claims.evidence: 'Ajikumar et al. (2010) successfully increased the production of taxadiene up to 1 g/L culture.'

verified_claims.claim: Engels et al. 2008 将酿酒酵母 taxadiene 滴度从 0.2 提升至 8.7 mg/L
verified_claims.evidence: 'The titer of taxadiene production increased from 0.2 to 8.7 mg/L by combined expression of different upstream genes with TXS (Engels et al., 2008).'

verified_claims.claim: E. coli K 株 taxadiene 产量比 B 株高 2.5 倍
verified_claims.evidence: 'E. coli K strain showed 2.5-fold greater production level of taxadiene than the B strain (Boghigian et al., 2012).'

verified_claims.claim: 拟南芥异源表达 TXS 产量 60 mg taxadiene/kg 干细胞重，番茄 160 mg/kg 果实，苔藓 0.05% 鲜重
verified_claims.evidence: 'Heterologous expression of TXS in higher plants such as A. thaliana (60 mg taxadiene/kg dry weight)… Expression of TXS in tomato… afforded 160 mg taxadiene/kg fruit… (0.05% fresh weight of tissue) (Anterola et al., 2009).'

verified_claims.claim: TXS 晶体结构由 Christianson 团队于 2011 年解析（Koksal et al., Nature 469:116–120），活性位点含 Y688 与 PPi 双路径去质子
verified_claims.evidence: 'Christianson and coworkers solved the X-ray crystal structure of TXS in 2011 (Koksal et al., 2011)… rendering a phenolic hydroxyl group of the active site Y688 to function as a general base (Fig. 2b) or exposing the inorganic pyrophosphate group (PPi) to function as base (Fig. 2c).'
